# Verità

> Verità is an iOS app that gives honest, personalized verdicts on beauty products. Scan a barcode, snap a photo, or search a product; Verità weighs ingredients and genuine review coverage against your skin and hair profile and answers plainly: worth it, or skip it — including when the answer is no.

- Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/verit%C3%A0/id6782425899
- No fake reviews, no invented data, no paid placements. Brands cannot pay for verdicts.
- Shop links may earn a commission; verdicts are generated before and independently of any link.
- Ingredient lists come from Open Beauty Facts, the user's label photo, or a named web page — never invented. Review coverage comes from a live web search and every verdict lists its sources.
- Built by Sofia Piniella in Miami, 2026.

## Site
- https://askverita.com/ : product overview — scanning, the live reading log, a real verdict with its sources, the beauty bag and build my routine
- https://askverita.com/about : the founder, Sofia Piniella, and why she built Verità
- https://askverita.com/faq : how reviews are verified, whether brands can pay, how the skin profile is built, where ingredient data comes from, makeup and hair coverage, data handling
- https://askverita.com/vs/verita-vs-yuka : how Verità differs from Yuka (personal verdict vs universal score)
- https://askverita.com/vs/verita-vs-think-dirty : how Verità differs from Think Dirty (personal verdict vs ingredient hazard rating)
- https://askverita.com/support : support — email info@askverita.com
- https://askverita.com/disclaimer : medical disclaimer — general information only, not medical advice
- https://askverita.com/privacy : privacy policy
- https://askverita.com/terms : terms of use
